statement: A claim is load-bearing only if it has an id, a grade, and a path to evidence. Unidentified sentences are not kernel.
The only performance measure is eta = useful_joules / human_joules. Other scores are commentary.
C(N,T,R) := N * 0.001 * (1 + 0.1*T) * (1-R)^T is a model function, not a measured physical energy.
R in [0,1] is the cooperation parameter of C. R=1.0 is the algebraic point where (1-R)^T = 0 for T>=1.
Irreversible bit erasure costs at least kT ln 2 joules (Landauer). Computation is physical.
Least-first: write the smallest live path that already exists before inventing a new tree. Empty directories are not a repo.
Proof-of-physical-work (PoPW) outranks proof-of-text. Mass, photo, pad log beat a demo row.
The chain is local chain.jsonl plus content-addressed store. A public ledger host is not existence of a hang.
Need-gate: a tree is integrated only when MANIFEST, CLAIMS, INTEGRATION notes exist and claims are graded.
Edges and marginals are first-class sites of yield.
Efficiency language is reservoir-scoped. Heat-engine eta, act eta, EROI, service-ratio, and fractal efficiency_per_joule must not be summed as one number.
Feedback is heat. A lock does not rewrite itself. Regulation acts on the next act, not on the already-hung blob.
Absolute paths only. Tilde and placeholder paths are defects of the emitter.
Design from patterns to details. Climate, pulse, and slope precede tanks, gel, lid, coil.
